section.heading: Provision of information concerning Earned Income Tax Credits.

para.text: At least once per year, the Mayor shall provide written notice ("notice") regarding the federal and District Earned Income Tax Credits ("tax credits") to the individuals identified in subsection (c) of this section.
A summary of the eligibility requirements for the tax credits;
The amount of the maximum allowable tax credits for different family sizes;
A summary of the process for applying for the tax credits, including the process for receiving monthly payments of the credits; and
A telephone number to call to receive additional information about the tax credits.
The notice shall be provided to:
Each TANF, POWER, SNAP, and Family Re-Housing Stabilization Program head of household; and
Each adult who receives Medicaid benefits or who is caring for a child who receives Medicaid benefits.

annotations.annotation: as added Apr. 20, 1999, D.C. Law 12-241, § 4(g), 46 DCR 905
